The tail is 230 uA, which gives slew near 115 V/us. Long L (about 1 um input, about 0.8 um load) gives gain near 38-39 dB. The PMOS mirror L is kept moderate so its pole stays near 2x UGBW or higher. Output swing is about 0.35-1.6 V."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (13.0, 9.0, 18.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # input pair L
    "gmid3": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),      # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),       # PMOS mirror L
    "gmid5": (11.0, 7.0, 15.0),     # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "L5":    (0.6, 0.3, 2.0),       # tail L
    "Itail": (240e-6, 150e-6, 400e-6),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    I1 = p["Itail"] / 2.0

    # devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=0.75)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], p["Itail"], vds=0.25)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], p["L5"], iref, vds=m5.vgs)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: diode-connected nfet sinks IREF
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # diff pair: vinp drives the diode side -> non-inverting to vout
    n.dev("M1", "nd", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # PMOS mirror load
    n.dev("M3", "nd", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "nd", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cmir = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fp2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fp2)))
    slew = p["Itail"] / cout
    vtail = 0.9 - m1.vgs
    vmin = max(vtail + m1.vdsat, 0.15) + 0.05
    vmax = vdd - m3.vdsat - 0.05
    swing = vmax - vmin
    psrr = db(a0) + 1.0  # mirror-load 5T: PSRR(VDD) ~ A0 at LF

    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "psrr_db": psrr, "swing": swing,
               "power": vdd * (p["Itail"] + iref)}
```
